name: Claude usage - relay to FMT dashboard
description: Receives daily Claude Code usage records (ClaudeDailyRecord) from the Cowork collector reading claude.ai Analytics, validates them, and forwards them to the stage or prod FMT dashboard import endpoint. dry_run posts are validated only.

options.renameFallbackOutput: Not sent (dry run, empty or rejected)

assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const b = $json.body ?? $json.data; const j = typeof b === 'string' ? JSON.parse(b) : b; return (j && typeof j === 'object') ? j : {}; } catch (e) { return {}; } })() }}

assignments.name: dashboard_body
assignments.value: ={{ $json.error ? 'request failed: ' + String($json.error.message || $json.error.description || JSON.stringify($json.error)).slice(0, 500) : ($json.headers?.location ? ($json.body ?? $json.data) : JSON.stringify($json.body ?? $json.data ?? "")).slice(0, 1500) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, $("Validate").first().json.summary, { dashboard_status: $json.dashboard_status ?? null, dashboard_ok: $json.dashboard_ok ?? null, batches: $json.batches ?? null, batches_ok: $json.batches_ok ?? null, dailyWritten: $json.dailyWritten ?? null, unmatchedWritten: $json.unmatchedWritten ?? null, unmatchedEmails: $json.unmatchedEmails ?? null, dashboard_body: $json.dashboard_body ?? null })) }}

parameters.content:
## Claude usage relay

The daily Cowork task reads claude.ai Analytics (Claude Code, Team plan) in the Work Chrome and posts one day of ClaudeDailyRecord rows here per request.

Validate checks the key and every record, then Route sends them to the stage or prod FMT dashboard import with the dashboard bearer credential. dry_run posts are validated only and never forwarded.

The dashboard upserts by (date, email), so resending a day is safe.

activeVersion.name: Split sends into batches under 80 KB; combine the dashboard answers
activeVersion.description: Stage answered 500 "request entity too large" for 471 records in one body (~100 KB server limit). Validate now splits records into batches of at most 80 KB of JSON, the send nodes post them one by one, and Combine results sums dailyWritten/unmatchedWritten and merges unmatchedEmails into one response.
